title: Volcanoes of El Salvador (hard)
intro: 10 volcanoes of El Salvador, one after another. Put your marker as near as you can; the nearer, the more points. Only the coasts are drawn and the full-points circle is small, so this is the hard version.

rounds.name: Santa Ana
rounds.fact: Santa Ana is a stratovolcano; the latest significant eruption recorded for it in the source data was in 2005. The data places it in El Salvador.
